name: expenses-run
description: Run one of Expense Tracker's declared operations. Destructive rows are marked in the description — confirm with the user before running one.

command.description: expenses.expense.reconcile-accept — Accept printed total (adjust tax); expenses.expense.trust-lines — Trust the lines (clear printed total); expenses.expense.toggle-reimbursable — Mark / unmark reimbursable; expenses.expense.toggle-disputed — Not my charge (toggle); expenses.expense.copy-line — Copy as a line; expenses.expense.delete — Delete expense (destructive); expenses.expense.delete-selected — Delete selected expenses (destructive); expenses.node.copy-subtotal — Copy this subtotal; expenses.add — Add expense; expenses.tab.float — Float as a window; expenses.tab.dock — Dock back into the strip; expenses.tab.close — Close tab (destructive); expenses.tab.close-others — Close other tabs; expenses.report.new — New report; expenses.report.open — Open report…; expenses.ledger.save — Save ledger…; expenses.ledger.load — Load ledger…; expenses.ledger.import — Import transactions…; expenses.ledger.scan-image — Scan statement images…; expenses.view.columns — View… (Columns dialog); expenses.col.toggle-<column> — show / hide one grid column (kind, category, account, lines, subtotal, tax, tip, printed, delta, total, balance, source, notes); expenses.col.show-all — View › Show all columns; expenses.actions.dupes — Actions › Dupe — find possible duplicates…; expenses.assistant.ask — Ask the assistant…; expenses.assistant.open — Open the assistant;expenses.filter.advanced — Advanced filter…; expenses.settings.open — Settings…; expenses.tabs.restore — Reopen the standard views

data.description: Context the row would have carried — the item, list or selection the command acts on.
